name: Time-MMD prospective unlabeled-shift abstention gate v1
status: frozen prospective protocol; do not evaluate or retune on already-inspected Train/Dev/Test periods

motivation_only_not_evidence.warning: The metric and threshold were selected after inspecting six Train walk-forward blocks. Their apparent filtering performance is post-hoc and cannot support a claim.

eligibility.undated_rows: abstain and exclude from temporal calibration
eligibility.reference_window: most recent 25% of the available dated training history, capped only by data availability

shift_statistic.name: maximum absolute standardized feature-mean shift
shift_statistic.feature_set: exact frozen numerical gate input vector; no labels, residuals, document text, target values, or future outcomes
shift_statistic.decision: ABSTAIN from all learned expert routing when statistic > threshold; otherwise apply the frozen recent-window gate

frozen_model_policy.threshold_selection: existing inner-OOF select_threshold implementation, past rows only

evaluation.unit: one genuinely future chronological block not previously inspected
evaluation.success: both sMAE and sRMSE non-regressing versus the frozen numerical baseline, with at least one strictly positive; report all abstentions
evaluation.failure: either primary metric regresses, or the gate fires on zero rows; no threshold retuning after the block is opened
controls: frozen recent-window gate without shift abstention

claim_boundary: Until the prospective block passes, describe covariate shift only as a diagnostic correlate and safety-gate hypothesis.
